mentions.name: Birthday Reminder Web App
mentions.description: A small personal web app that takes in friends' and family birthdays and sends the owner a reminder a set amount of time before each date, along with suggestions for birthday gifts. Suggestions are currently manually entered ideas, with plans to plug in known interests to produce better gift recommendations.
mentions.problem: With friends all having kids, it is becoming more and more to keep track of everyone's birthdays in the calendar.
mentions.source_excerpt: In my spare time I've been working on a small service for making sure I remember friends and families birthdays. I think it's really important but with friends all having kids it's becoming more and more to keep track of in the calendar. I'm putting together a small web app which takes in the birthday and sends me a reminder a set amount of time away, with some suggestions for birthday gifts.
